name: metamuseum
title: the metamuseum of the internet
blurb: a museum of this bot's own back catalog: every site it has built gets a full wall-text plaque — provenance (who asked, and when), the wing it hangs in, the artistic tradition that wing documents, and its critical reception (borrowed straight from sites/receipts' own roasts). recursively, the museum has a plaque about itself too, in its own east wing. now also has an annex that does the literal thing a 'meta' museum is supposed to do -- lists the constellation's other actual museums (reygallery, reygiftshop, apocrypha, slopfair, receipts) -- after shimmermathlabs.com came back to say a meta museum should list other museums, not just itself. proposed in a thread by norvid-studies.bsky.social and shimmermathlabs.com as a museum of the internet with full contextual wall text; asked for by shimmermathlabs.com.
